title: Migrations: Tables banana aur Chalana
objectives: Migration kya hai aur kyun zaroori hai samajhna

sections.heading: Migration kya hai?
sections.body:
Migration database ka **version control** hai. Table kaise banti hai, yeh PHP code mein likhte ho, aur poori team ek command se same schema bana leti hai. Kisi teammate se manually column jodne ko nahi kehna padta.

Migration files `database/migrations` mein hoti hain, aur file ke naam ke timestamp se Laravel unka order samajhta hai.

sections.heading: Real-world example: products table
sections.body: Store ke liye `products` table banate hain. Pehle migration file generate karo:

code.code:
<?php

use Illuminate\Database\Migrations\Migration;
use Illuminate\Database\Schema\Blueprint;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;

return new class extends Migration
{
    public function up(): void
    {
        Schema::create('products', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id();
            $table->string('name');
            $table->text('description')->nullable();
            $table->decimal('price', 8, 2);
            $table->unsignedInteger('stock')->default(0);
            $table->timestamps();
        });
    }

    public function down(): void
    {
        Schema::dropIfExists('products');
    }
};

explain: `create_products_table` naam se Laravel samajh jaata hai ki `products` table banani hai aur stub pehle se bhar deta hai.
`up()` – migration chalane par kya hoga. `down()` – rollback par kya hoga.
`return new class extends Migration` – anonymous class, naam takraav nahi hota.

sections.heading: Migrations chalana
sections.body: Yeh commands rozana kaam aati hain:

code.code:
php artisan migrate
php artisan migrate:status
php artisan migrate --pretend
php artisan migrate:rollback
php artisan migrate:rollback --step=1
php artisan migrate:fresh
php artisan migrate:fresh --seed
php artisan migrate:refresh

explain: `rollback` – aakhri batch undo. `--step=1` se sirf ek migration.
`migrate:fresh` – saari tables **drop** karke dobara migrate. Production mein kabhi nahi!

callout.text: `migrate:fresh` aur `migrate:refresh` data mita dete hain. Sirf development mein chalao.

sections.heading: Existing table mein column jodna
sections.body: Kal tumhe `sku` column chahiye. Purani migration edit mat karo, **nayi migration** banao. Naam `add_..._to_..._table` rakhoge to Laravel table pehchan leta hai.
explain: `down()` mein exactly undo karo jo `up()` ne kiya.

callout.text: Rule: jo migration kisi aur ke paas ya production par chal chuki hai, use kabhi edit mat karo. Naya badlaav hamesha nayi migration mein.

sections.heading: Schema dump (jab migrations bahut ho jayein)
sections.body: Hazaaron migrations ho jaayein to `schema:dump` se unhe ek SQL file mein squash kar sakte ho:

code.code:
php artisan schema:dump
php artisan schema:dump --prune

versionDiff.heading: Migrations: Laravel 11, 12, 13
versionDiff.intro: Migration syntax (anonymous class, `up()`, `down()`) aur commands teeno versions mein same hain.

items.11: Anonymous migration classes aur `up(): void` style standard hai. Naye project mein users, cache, jobs migrations pehle se hoti hain.
items.13: Same. Official docs ke migrations page par commands aur options ki latest list dekh lo.

errors.error: SQLSTATE[HY000]: General error: 1 table "products" already exists
errors.cause: Table pehle se database mein hai (migration dobara ya manually chali).
errors.fix: Development mein `php artisan migrate:fresh`. Production mein conflict hata ke sahi migration chalao.

errors.cause: Saari migrations pehle hi chal chuki hain, ya nayi file banayi nahi.

errors.error: Class ... not found / Target class does not exist (migration)
errors.cause: Migration file ka naam ya class conflict hua.
errors.fix: Anonymous class (`return new class extends Migration`) use karo.

debug.body: Kya chala aur kya baaki hai `migrate:status` batata hai. SQL dekhna ho to `--pretend`.

code.code:
php artisan migrate:status
php artisan migrate --pretend

tasks: `create_products_table` banao (name, description nullable, price, stock) aur chalao
`migrate:status` se dekho ki chali ya nahi
`migrate:rollback --step=1` se sku wali migration undo karo aur dobara chalao

quiz.q: Table banane ke liye kaunsa method use hota hai?
quiz.why: `Schema::create()` nayi table banata hai. `Schema::table()` existing table badalta hai.

quiz.q: Chali hui migration mein naya column chahiye to?
quiz.why: Chali hui migration edit nahi karte, nayi migration banate hain.

quiz.q: Saari tables drop karke dobara migrate karne ki command?
quiz.why: `migrate:fresh` saari tables drop karke migrate chalata hai.

interview.a: Database schema ka version control. Table aur column badlaav PHP code mein likhe jaate hain, jo team ke saath share hote hain.
`up()` migration chalane par, `down()` rollback par chalta hai aur `up()` ka ulta karta hai.
`fresh` saari tables drop karta hai. `refresh` migrations ko `down()` se rollback karke dobara chalata hai.

interview.q: Chali hui migration ko edit kyun nahi karte?
interview.a: Doosre environments par woh pehle chal chuki hoti hai, to edit wahan apply nahi hoti. Nayi migration se badlaav sabko milta hai.

interview.q: Migration ka order kaise decide hota hai?
interview.a: File ke naam ke timestamp se.

summary: Badlaav ke liye nayi migration, purani edit nahi.
